title: Matched Task Selection

selected_task.name: InventoryOps Portal Lite
selected_task.description: A full-stack inventory management admin portal with CRUD operations, role-based access, and reporting. Synthetic — no real data, no secrets, no deployment.
requirements: CRUD for inventory items (name, sku, quantity, location, status)
Role-based access: admin (full CRUD), operator (view + update quantity), viewer (read-only)
Dashboard with summary stats (total items, low stock alerts, by location)
REST API with pagination, filtering, sorting
Backend: Python FastAPI or Node.js Express
Package QA: final ZIP handoff with manifest
One deploy-trace fixture: .env.production.example (empty template, no real secrets)
One safety-sensitive scenario: alert when deleting items with stock > 0
selected_task.complexity: MEDIUM — enough to test Factory value (gates, structure, policy)

selection_rationale: InventoryOps provides sufficient complexity (CRUD, RBAC, API, DB, tests, handoff) to exercise Build Lite structure, Security Gate triggers, Package QA gate, and Test Repair Policy — without requiring real secrets or deployment.
